# Akari zsh-syntax-highlighting Theme

zsh-syntax-highlighting themes for Akari. A terminal color palette inspired by Japanese alleys lit by round lanterns.

## Requirements

- [zsh-syntax-highlighting](https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting)

> [!WARNING]
> This theme must be loaded **after** zsh-syntax-highlighting.
> The theme works by overriding `ZSH_HIGHLIGHT_STYLES` variables set by zsh-syntax-highlighting.

## Installation

### Manual

Source the theme file in your `.zshrc`:

```bash
source /path/to/akari-night.zsh
```

Or for dawn:

```bash
source /path/to/akari-dawn.zsh
```

## Variants

- **akari-night.zsh** - A dark palette inspired by Japanese alleys lit by round lanterns.
- **akari-dawn.zsh** - A light palette inspired by Japanese alleys lit by round lanterns.
